title: Digital Estate commerce profile and its attestation
description: ADR-SHARED-042 section 14, Decision 8 (Platform Owner, 22 October 2026): the Control Plane is the sole authority for the governed commercial-experience classification of a Digital Estate. An EstateCommerceProfile says which commerce model (B2B or B2C) one Digital Estate is authorised to operate on one Trade engine instance in a Market scope. It is a governed, versioned record established during Digital Estate onboarding and independently approved before activation, never a free-form string in estate metadata. Exactly one ACTIVE profile applies to an estate within one engine instance and Market; a future hybrid estate needs separately governed, unambiguous native commitment bindings, and there is no implicit MIXED model. Nothing infers the model from a sales channel, domain, currency, engine customer type or caller-supplied flag, and the names of initial estates (ZuriBeans B2B, Thamani B2C) are requirements for their governed registration, not facts a consumer may assume. The attestation is short-lived context for one Trade workload request: it classifies the estate, it does not classify a native commitment (Trade does, trade/v2 native-commitment-classification.schema.json) and it grants no seller, buyer, market or purchasing authority. The existing estate-client binding (estate-client-binding.schema.json) says which estate a BFF serves; it does not say whether a commitment is B2B or B2C. This contract registers no workload allocation and activates nothing.

commerceModel.description: B2B: commitments are made on behalf of a buyer Organisation under ADR-SHARED-042 buyer authority. B2C: consumer commerce under its own separately governed buyer, payment and native-execution controls.

profileStatus.description: Only ACTIVE inside its effective interval can be attested. SUSPENDED may return to ACTIVE through a governed change with a new revision; REVOKED is terminal.

evidenceReference.description: Redacted, auditable provenance (for example a change-set or approval-decision id). Never a credential or unnecessary personal data.

EstateCommerceProfile.description: The governed record. CP owns its lifecycle: revision is CP-controlled and strictly increasing, every change is approved, and a change of commerce_model is a new profile superseding the old one, never an in-place edit.

market_scope.description: The canonical CP Markets the profile applies to.

supersedes.description: The profile this one replaces, for example on a governed change of commerce model.

EstateCommerceProfileResolveRequest.description: The calling Trade workload names an estate it already holds governed provenance for (a current estate-client binding attestation for a BFF request, or a separately governed workload or native-resource assignment for an administrative, scheduled or other non-BFF operation) and the Market of the commitment. It cannot name a tenant, profile, model or revision.

estate_provenance.description: How the caller knows the estate. CP re-verifies it; it is never trusted as asserted.

EstateCommerceProfileAttestation.description: CP's attestation that exactly one ACTIVE, currently effective profile matches the estate, the calling Trade instance and the Market. expires_at is at most 60 seconds after issued_at and never later than the profile's effective_until, which the attestation carries when the profile has one, so no consumer can rely on a classification after the profile stops being effective. A consumer re-resolves outside that window and rejects any revision older than one it has seen. It classifies the estate only.

profile_effective_until.description: The profile's effective_until, present whenever the profile has one. expires_at never exceeds it.

EstateCommerceProfileDenialCode.description: Closed problem codes (errors/v1 problem-details code). Every denial is fail-closed and discloses no other estate, tenant or profile. PROFILE_NOT_REGISTERED: no profile exists for the estate, engine instance and Market. PROFILE_NOT_ACTIVE: the only matching profile is SUSPENDED, REVOKED or outside its effective interval. PROFILE_AMBIGUOUS: more than one profile applies; nothing is attested and no order resolves it. ESTATE_PROVENANCE_INVALID: the stated estate provenance does not verify for the caller. ENGINE_INSTANCE_NOT_PERMITTED: the caller is not the profile's Trade instance. RESOLUTION_UNAVAILABLE: the registry or its dependencies are unavailable; never a fallback model.
